# Hickory Grove Christian School — College Support (School Profile Research 2026)

- **School:** Hickory Grove Christian School (HGCS), 7200 E. WT Harris Blvd., Charlotte, NC
 28215. **CEEB Code: 340661** (confirmed on both profiles).
- **Two profile years captured — each figure is tagged to its year:**
 - **Fall 2025 profile (2025-2026):** Class of 2025 outcomes, Class of 2026 test scores,
 AP May 2025, National Recognition 2019-2025, AP Scholars 2024-2025, and the 2025
 acceptance list. This is the CURRENT profile.
 - **Fall 2023 profile (2023-2024):** Class of 2023 outcomes, Class of 2024 test scores,
 AP May 2023, National Recognition 2019-2023, AP Scholars 2022-2023, and the 2023
 acceptance list. Retained for the known-facts cross-check.

Composition, Biology, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Statistics, Calculus AB, Calculus BC,

**AP course list (Fall 2023, S2) — differs:** English Language and Composition, English
Literature and Composition, Biology, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Statistics, Calculus AB,
Calculus BC, US History, US Government and Politics, Human Geography, Computer Science A,
Psychology, Spanish Language & Culture, Studio Art 2-D, AP Seminar, and AP Research. (Fall 2023
additionally listed Human Geography, Computer Science A, and Spanish Language & Culture; Fall
2025 dropped these three from the printed list.)

### AP scores — May 2025 (S1, current)

- **82 HGCS students took a total of 176 AP exams in May 2025.**
- 29 students earned a **5** on one or more AP exams.
- 59 students earned a **4** on one or more AP exams.
- 53 students earned a **3** on one or more AP exams.

(Note: these counts are "students scoring X on one or more exams" — they overlap, and are NOT
mutually exclusive tiers. The profile does not publish a per-exam 1-5 distribution.)

### AP scores — May 2023 (S2)

- **83 HGCS students took a total of 169 AP exams in May 2023.**
- 21 students earned a **5** on one or more AP exams.
- 44 students earned a **4** on one or more AP exams.
- **57 students earned a 3** on one or more AP exams.

(Confirms brief's known fact: 83 students / 169 exams; "57 scored 3+" in the brief maps to the
57-students-earned-a-3 line here — read the profile's phrasing exactly: it is 57 students who
earned a 3, not a cumulative 3+ count.)

sections.text:
- **This is not the university's admit rate, and not the school's selectivity.** It is
 the rate at which that university admitted *this high school's* applicants — a joint
 property of the pair. Label it that way wherever it is surfaced.
- **Carry the denominator.** Several cells here are single-digit; a 100% rate off 2
 applicants is not comparable to one off 200, and a bare percentage from a
 single-digit base must not be published.
- **UNC-system campuses only.** This says nothing about private or out-of-state
 destinations, so it complements a matriculation list and never replaces one.
